name: Alte Post
beschreibung: The Gasthof Alte Post is situated in Gries am Brenner along the historic Brenner Pass route. Formerly a postal staging post, the property is now operated as an authentic alpine inn with an attached restaurant. The guest rooms are equipped with showers and toilets, with select rooms offering balconies. The restaurant serves traditional Tyrolean food and drinks prepared with locally sourced ingredients. A compact sauna area is available for relaxation. Hiking and cycling trails start right outside the door. Located just a few kilometers from the Brenner motorway, the inn is equally convenient for transit travelers and active outdoor enthusiasts.
